    {

      "stance": "objection",

    },
    {
      "login": "ismaelsadeeq",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK"

    {

  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:4045093793",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "removes test coverage for the mempool v1 reading path",
      "quote": "Shouldn't this set `-persistmempoolv1=1`, so that the reading path is still covered? Otherwise you are removing coverage",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "Author restored coverage with the option in a push; reviewer re-approved with lgtm",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4045338124"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5247322119",
      "status_by_quote": "lgtm"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4046345819",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "use the latest release instead of oldest, or update the comment accordingly",
      "quote": "I think we prefer the last release (aka youngest, not oldest), or the comment should say \"Any release with ...\"",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "Author updated release version to v31 and updated comment in follow-up commit",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4053168196"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4053168196",
      "status_by_quote": "I changed the version to v31 and updated the comment"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4046346312",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "whether dropping implicit coverage for deserialization failure logging matters",
      "quote": "This still drops coverage for `        LogInfo(\"Failed to deserialize mempool data on file: %s. Continuing anyway.\\n\", e.what());`, but I guess the coverage there was only implicit (due to missing unbroadcast set), and we don't really care about it anyway?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "Author confirmed coverage was incidental and added explicit coverage in mempool_persist.py",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4053209738"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4053209738",
      "status_by_quote": "Right, since we didn't have an explicit check for it, it seems like this coverage was mostly incidental. But some general coverage of a failing import on a malformed mempool file seems like a good idea, so I added that in a separate commit and put it into `mempool_persist.py` since that seems a more fitting place."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5426420518",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "clarify in the release note that reading existing legacy mempool.dat files remains supported",
      "quote": "could we add “Reading existing legacy `mempool.dat` files remains supported”?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5245796692",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "Seems fine. If anyone really wanted to write this, they can just use a previous release and do a start-stop with -persistmempoolv1=1",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": [
        "test/functional/mempool_compatibility.py"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5247322119",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "lgtm",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5793173212",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Concept ACK",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5426420518",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "removing this makes sense since the option was temporary and the versions it helped downgrade to are unsupported now",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "respond to musaHaruna's release note suggestion",
      "id": "r:5426420518"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added musaHaruna's Concept ACK and suggestion regarding release notes. Carried over maflcko's test coverage objection (which was fixed) and added maflcko's review suggestions/questions that were addressed by the author."
}
